title: Insured Plan of Care Authorization and the Appointment Series Portal Booking Limit
content:
Revenue Cycle memo on how the funding Insured Plan of Care limits an insured portal booking on an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The insured portal plan limit is the plan's authorized visits remaining less the appointments still booked on the series where the payer program of the funding plan requires prior authorization and the plan's authorization end date has not passed, the maximum appointments in one booking of the series' format where the payer program requires no prior authorization and the plan's benefits were verified fewer than 12 whole months before the booking date, and 4 appointments in every other case.

**Records read.** From the funding Insured Plan of Care: whether its payer program requires prior authorization, the authorization end date, the authorized visits remaining and the date benefits were verified. From the series: the appointments still booked.

| Payer program | Further condition on the plan | Insured portal plan limit |
|---|---|---|
| requires prior authorization | authorization end date on or after the booking date | authorized visits remaining less the appointments still booked on the series |
| requires no prior authorization | benefits verified fewer than 12 whole months before the booking date | the format's maximum appointments in one booking |
| any other case | — | 4 appointments |

| Visit format | Maximum appointments in one booking |
|---|---|
| Telehealth, Standard 45-Minute and Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 12 |
| Aquatic Therapy and Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 8 |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 18 |

**Cases (hypothetical).**

- Prior authorization required, authorization ending next month, 6 authorized visits remaining, 2 appointments still booked: the limit is 4.
- Prior authorization required but the authorization end date was yesterday: the limit is 4 appointments.
- No prior authorization, benefits verified on 1 March of last year, booking on 28 February: 11 whole months, so an Aquatic Therapy Visit Series limit is 8. Booking on 1 March instead: 12 whole months, so the limit is 4.
